_approach: The canonical krushclub skeleton: the Jersey Club 5-kick pattern (beat 1, beat 2, beat 3, the 'a' of 3, the '&' of 4 — RYM/production-guide consensus) left untouched, but the bed-squeak sample (clave slot) is chopped into the a-of-3/&-of-4 pocket the way krushclub producers do, and the clap+snare 2-and-4 backbeat is doubled up and pitched for a hyperpop-adjacent stack rather than a single clean Jersey clap. Bitcrushed closed hats sit low so the 5-kick shape reads clearly. This is the pattern that is 'still Jersey Club' before any HexD processing is applied. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
